summary: PT Telkom Indonesia filed a 6-K disclosing a shareholder buyback right tied to dissenters of its approved partial spin-off of the Wholesale Fiber Connectivity Business (Phase 2) to 99.99%-owned PT Telkom Infrastruktur Indonesia (TIF). The EGMS on September 30, 2026 approved the spin-off, triggering Article 62 of Indonesia's Company Law, which grants dissenting public shareholders a right to sell shares to the company at a reasonable price. Record date was September 7, 2026; buyback capped at 10% of issued capital, subject to net-asset tests.
